text.en: A local-first workspace for building, editing, saving, importing, exporting, transposing, and performing guitar charts.
text.zhTW: 以本機優先方式建立、編輯、儲存、匯入、匯出、移調與演出吉他譜的工作區。

text.en: Song Workspace combines a saved-song library, structured chart editor, chord-shape tools, reading controls, and Performance Mode. Song content remains in browser storage unless the user explicitly imports or exports a file.
text.zhTW: 歌曲工作區整合已儲存歌曲資料庫、結構化譜面編輯器、和弦指型工具、閱讀控制與演出模式。歌曲內容保留在瀏覽器儲存空間，除非使用者明確匯入或匯出檔案。

text.en: The implementation addresses the gap between a static chord reference and the longer workflow of preparing, revising, reading, and performing a complete guitar chart.
text.zhTW: 從實作回溯可見，它處理靜態和弦參考與完整吉他譜準備、修改、閱讀及演出流程之間的落差。

text.en: Create a chart from scratch or imports, organize sections and lines, attach chord shapes, adjust key/capo/reading settings, save locally, and open a focused performance view.
text.zhTW: 從空白或匯入內容建立譜面、整理段落與行、附加和弦指型、調整調性／移調夾／閱讀設定、儲存於本機並開啟專注演出檢視。

text.en: The product and its repository tests explicitly maintain a local-first, no-lyrics-egress boundary.
text.zhTW: 產品與儲存庫測試明確維持本機優先及歌詞不外傳的邊界。

text.en: The feature first existed in Git on August 26 and reached canonical main through PR #5 on August 28 as Song Workspace v1.0.0.
text.zhTW: 此功能於 8 月 26 日首次出現在 Git，並於 8 月 28 日透過 PR #5 進入正式 main，成為歌曲工作區 v1.0.0。

text.en: Local saved-song library, new-song flow, ChordPro and Jam Tracks Hub JSON imports, and explicit exports.
text.zhTW: 本機已儲存歌曲資料庫、新增歌曲流程、ChordPro 與 Jam Tracks Hub JSON 匯入，以及明確匯出。

text.en: Structured sections and lyric/chord lines, transposition and capo tools, chord diagrams, and Performance Mode.
text.zhTW: 結構化段落與歌詞／和弦行、移調與移調夾工具、和弦圖及演出模式。

text.en: IndexedDB song storage with preferences kept separately and validated before use.
text.zhTW: 使用 IndexedDB 儲存歌曲，偏好設定分開保存並在使用前驗證。

text.en: Home view → Create Song and imports → My Songs library → editor with settings, chart, and chord-shape panel → Performance Mode.
text.zhTW: 首頁檢視 → 建立歌曲與匯入 → 我的歌曲資料庫 → 含設定、譜面與和弦指型面板的編輯器 → 演出模式。

text.en: My Songs was a view inside song-workspace.html, not a separate public HTML page.
text.zhTW: 「我的歌曲」是 song-workspace.html 內的檢視，而不是獨立公開 HTML 頁面。

text.en: song-workspace.html defines the library, editor, dialogs, shape picker, global-add flow, and performance view.
text.zhTW: song-workspace.html 定義資料庫、編輯器、對話框、指型選擇器、全域新增流程與演出檢視。

text.en: scripts/song-workspace-core.js owns song/section/line models, validation, chord parsing, transposition, lyric alignment, imports, exports, and reading calculations.
text.zhTW: scripts/song-workspace-core.js 管理歌曲／段落／行模型、驗證、和弦解析、移調、歌詞對齊、匯入、匯出與閱讀計算。

text.en: scripts/song-workspace-storage.js isolates IndexedDB operations and bounded preference normalization.
text.zhTW: scripts/song-workspace-storage.js 隔離 IndexedDB 操作與有界偏好正規化。

text.en: scripts/song-workspace.js coordinates library rendering, editing, dialogs, responsive reading controls, chord-shape selection, autosave state, and Performance Mode.
text.zhTW: scripts/song-workspace.js 協調資料庫渲染、編輯、對話框、響應式閱讀控制、和弦指型選擇、自動儲存狀態與演出模式。

text.en: scripts/chord-shapes.js supplies reusable public chord parsing, voicing, and diagram models without reading private saved songs.
text.zhTW: scripts/chord-shapes.js 提供可重用的公開和弦解析、配置與圖表模型，不讀取私人已儲存歌曲。

text.en: Editor controls, score, and chord-shape references use the available width as a multi-region workspace.
text.zhTW: 編輯器控制、譜面與和弦指型參考會利用可用寬度形成多區域工作區。

text.en: The editor and settings reflow, while disclosure panels and reading controls preserve a coherent order.
text.zhTW: 編輯器與設定會重新排列，揭露面板與閱讀控制仍保有一致順序。

text.en: Several August 28–30 fixes targeted mobile add flows, compact reading, dialog positioning, lyric/chord alignment, and entrance behavior rather than simply shrinking the desktop layout.
text.zhTW: 8 月 28 至 30 日多項修正針對行動版新增流程、精簡閱讀、對話框定位、歌詞／和弦對齊與進場行為，而非只縮小桌面版。

text.en: The first public release established the local-first library, editor, shared shapes, imports/exports, and performance workflow.
text.zhTW: 首個公開版本建立本機優先資料庫、編輯器、共用指型、匯入／匯出與演出流程。

text.en: PR #6 refined workspace responsiveness while also restoring a Homepage regression.
text.zhTW: PR #6 改善工作區響應式，同時修復首頁回歸。

text.en: Common add actions and mobile alignment became more direct.
text.zhTW: 常用新增操作與行動版對齊變得更直接。

text.en: Settings, editing controls, and responsive layouts received a focused revision.
text.zhTW: 設定、編輯控制與響應式版面獲得重點改版。

text.en: Saved-song management and smart navigation became more cohesive.
text.zhTW: 已儲存歌曲管理與智慧導覽變得更一致。

text.en: The release recorded public-safe hardening and protection milestones without disclosing defensive internals.
text.zhTW: 此版本以公開安全方式記錄強化與保護里程碑，不揭露防禦內部細節。

text.en: Browser storage reduces account and server requirements and supports the privacy boundary, while making explicit import/export and recovery paths more important.
text.zhTW: 瀏覽器儲存減少帳號與伺服器需求並支援隱私邊界，但也讓明確匯入／匯出與復原路徑更重要。

text.en: Sections, lines, chords, and anchors enable transposition and performance behavior, but demand strong validation at every import and storage boundary.
text.zhTW: 段落、行、和弦與錨點支援移調與演出行為，但也要求每個匯入與儲存邊界都有嚴謹驗證。

text.en: Keeping My Songs, editor, dialogs, and Performance Mode inside one page preserves state continuity, while increasing interaction and responsive complexity.
text.zhTW: 將我的歌曲、編輯器、對話框與演出模式放在同一頁可維持狀態連續性，但也增加互動與響應式複雜度。

text.en: The public product is an English/Traditional Chinese, local-first browser workspace with a saved-song library, structured editor, reusable chord diagrams, import/export, reading controls, and Performance Mode. Its public history intentionally excludes user song titles, lyrics, metadata, and local database contents.
text.zhTW: 目前公開產品是支援英文／繁體中文、以本機優先的瀏覽器工作區，含已儲存歌曲資料庫、結構化編輯器、可重用和弦圖、匯入／匯出、閱讀控制與演出模式。其公開歷史刻意排除使用者歌曲標題、歌詞、中繼資料與本機資料庫內容。

text.en: Local-first is a product architecture, not only a storage choice: disclosures, imports, exports, validation, and recovery all have to reinforce the same boundary.
text.zhTW: 本機優先是產品架構，不只是儲存選擇：揭露、匯入、匯出、驗證與復原都必須強化同一邊界。

text.en: A dense editor needs viewport-specific workflows; the sequence of mobile fixes shows that reflow alone is not enough for add, dialog, and reading tasks.
text.zhTW: 高密度編輯器需要針對視窗設計流程；一連串行動版修正顯示，僅重新排列不足以處理新增、對話框與閱讀任務。

text.en: No original user-research study or wireframe was found; documented implementation and release evidence supports the behavior, but not claims about user preference or adoption.
text.zhTW: 未找到原始使用者研究或線框圖；實作與版本證據可支持行為描述，但不能支持使用者偏好或採用情況的主張。
